# Register map v0.3

BAR0, XDMA AXI-Lite master. 32-bit registers, byte offsets, one 4 KiB block per subsystem.

## CTL — 0x0000

Identity, scratch, status and board telemetry.

| Offset | Name | Access | Reset | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0x0000 | `ID` | RO | 0x46504741 | Constant 0x46504741 ('FPGA'). |
| 0x0004 | `VERSION` | RO | 0x3 | Register-map version.<br>`[15:0]` MINOR<br>`[31:16]` MAJOR |
| 0x0008 | `SCRATCH` | RW | 0x0 | Free read/write word for host access tests. |
| 0x000C | `STATUS` | RO | 0x0 | Live status bits.<br>`[0]` LINK_UP — PCIe user link up (from XDMA).<br>`[1]` MEM_READY — Ring-buffer memory calibrated / ready.<br>`[2]` SNK_ERR — Sink has counted at least one error since clear.<br>`[3]` RING_OVERFLOW — Ring buffer dropped data since clear. |
| 0x0010 | `TEMP` | RO | 0x0 | SYSMON die temperature, raw 10-bit code in [15:6] as SYSMON reports it. |
| 0x0014 | `PWR_MW` | RO | 0x0 | Card input power in mW from the INA telemetry; 0 if absent. |

## SRC — 0x1000

AXI-Stream test source (to C2H).

| Offset | Name | Access | Reset | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0x1000 | `SRC_CTL` | RW | 0x0 | Source control.<br>`[0]` EN — Generate beats while set.<br>`[1]` MODE — 0 = counter, 1 = PRBS-31. |
| 0x1004 | `SRC_RATE` | RW | 0x10000 | Beats offered per 2^16 clock cycles; >= 0x10000 means every cycle. |
| 0x1008 | `SRC_BEATS_LO` | RO | 0x0 | Beats accepted downstream, low word; reading it latches _HI. |
| 0x100C | `SRC_BEATS_HI` | RO | 0x0 | High word as of the last SRC_BEATS_LO read. |
| 0x1010 | `SRC_CLEAR` | WO (pulse) | 0x0 | Bit 0: reset the beat counter and pattern state. |

## SNK — 0x2000

AXI-Stream checker (from H2C).

| Offset | Name | Access | Reset | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0x2000 | `SNK_CTL` | RW | 0x0 | Sink control.<br>`[0]` EN — Check incoming beats while set (always accepts).<br>`[1]` MODE — Expected pattern: 0 = counter, 1 = PRBS-31. |
| 0x2004 | `SNK_ERRS` | RO | 0x0 | Beats that did not match the expected pattern. |
| 0x2008 | `SNK_BEATS_LO` | RO | 0x0 | Beats received, low word; reading it latches _HI. |
| 0x200C | `SNK_BEATS_HI` | RO | 0x0 | High word as of the last SNK_BEATS_LO read. |
| 0x2010 | `SNK_CLEAR` | WO (pulse) | 0x0 | Bit 0: reset counters and pattern state. |

## RING — 0x3000

Ring buffer in front of C2H, filled from the source, H2C or the slot; BRAM or DDR4.

| Offset | Name | Access | Reset | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0x3000 | `RING_CTL` | RW | 0x0 | Ring control.<br>`[1:0]` SRC_SEL — Ring source: 0 = test source, 1 = H2C (loopback), 2 = slot m_axis, 3 = none (reserved). The sink always checks H2C; H2C reaches the slot only when 2.<br>`[0]` LOOPBACK (alias) — SRC_SEL bit 0, the v0.2 name: writing just this bit selects H2C. |
| 0x3004 | `RING_DEPTH` | RO | 0x0 | Capacity in 256-bit beats. |
| 0x3008 | `RING_FILL` | RO | 0x0 | Beats currently stored. |
| 0x300C | `RING_CLEAR` | WO (pulse) | 0x0 | Bit 0: empty the ring and clear OVERFLOW. |

## TS — 0x4000

64-bit counter of shell clock cycles (axi_aclk, 250 MHz) and PPS capture. It resets to 0 with the PCIe link (axi_aresetn), so time restarts on every link reset and rescan reload. The slot sees the live counter.

| Offset | Name | Access | Reset | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0x4000 | `TS_LATCH` | WO (pulse) | 0x0 | Bit 0: copy the live counter into TS_NOW_*. |
| 0x4004 | `TS_NOW_LO` | RO | 0x0 | Counter at the last TS_LATCH, low word; reading it latches _HI. |
| 0x4008 | `TS_NOW_HI` | RO | 0x0 | High word as of the last TS_NOW_LO read. |
| 0x400C | `TS_PPS_LO` | RO | 0x0 | Counter at the last PPS rising edge, low word; reading it latches _HI. The edge is 2 cycles older than the capture (synchroniser). |
| 0x4010 | `TS_PPS_HI` | RO | 0x0 | High word as of the last TS_PPS_LO read. |
| 0x4014 | `TS_PPS_COUNT` | RO | 0x0 | PPS rising edges since reset (wraps). |

## IRQ — 0x5000

Interrupts: usr_irq_req[0] is high while IRQ_PENDING & IRQ_EN is non-zero. usr_irq_req is a held level and MSI-X fires only on its rising edge, so after clearing IRQ_PENDING the host must re-read it until it reads 0 under IRQ_EN before waiting for the next interrupt.

| Offset | Name | Access | Reset | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0x5000 | `IRQ_EN` | RW | 0x0 | Per-source enable.<br>`[0]` FORCE — IRQ_FORCE write (latency test).<br>`[1]` PPS — PPS rising edge (the TS_PPS capture).<br>`[2]` SNK_ERR — STATUS.SNK_ERR went 0 -> 1 (once per error run).<br>`[3]` SLOT — The slot's slot_irq level: re-latches while it is high, so clearing sticks only after the project drops it. |
| 0x5004 | `IRQ_PENDING` | RW1C | 0x0 | Latched sources (set whether or not enabled); write 1 to clear. A set wins over a clear in the same cycle.<br>`[0]` FORCE — IRQ_FORCE write (latency test).<br>`[1]` PPS — PPS rising edge (the TS_PPS capture).<br>`[2]` SNK_ERR — STATUS.SNK_ERR went 0 -> 1 (once per error run).<br>`[3]` SLOT — The slot's slot_irq level: re-latches while it is high, so clearing sticks only after the project drops it. |
| 0x5008 | `IRQ_COUNT` | RO | 0x0 | Rising edges of usr_irq_req since reset (wraps). |
| 0x500C | `IRQ_FORCE` | WO (pulse) | 0x0 | Bit 0: set IRQ_PENDING.FORCE now.<br>`[0]` FORCE |

## SLOT — 0x6000

Shell-side control of the project slot, out of the project's reach. The project's own registers are on BAR2 (SLOT_ID at 0x0, SLOT_VERSION at 0x4).

| Offset | Name | Access | Reset | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0x6000 | `SLOT_CTL` | RW | 0x0 | Slot control.<br>`[0]` RESET — Hold the slot in reset (slot_clear) while set; the link stays up.<br>`[1]` DECOUPLE — Reserved for partial reconfiguration; no effect yet. |
